KiteConfig 3.1.0 now supports AGP 9.4 and 9.5 and Compose 1.13. This small release has 5 changes. Nothing in the API breaks.

## Usage

```kotlin
// Gradle projects: the root build.gradle.kts
plugins {
    id("io.github.yuroyami.kiteconfig") version "3.1.0"
}
```

For a Kotlin Toolchain project, run this in the folder that holds `project.yaml`:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/main/toolchain/install-kiteconfig.sh | bash -s 3.1.0
```

If you already use the Kotlin Toolchain plugin module, run the same command to update it. The [Kotlin Toolchain guide](https://github.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/blob/main/toolchain/README.md) has the full setup.

## Dependencies

| | Version |
|:--|:--|
| Kotlin | **2.4.21** (built with), KGP 2.4.x supported |
| Android Gradle Plugin | 9.5.0 (built with), 8.5.2 through 9.5.x supported |
| Compose Multiplatform | 1.13.0-beta01 (built with), 1.11.0 through 1.13.x supported |
| Gradle | 9.9.0-rc-1 (built with), 8.5 or newer supported |
| JDK | 21 (built with), JVM bytecode 17 |

Targets: Android, iOS and desktop apps in Gradle projects. Kotlin Toolchain projects get `KiteBuildConfig`, the Xcode sync and the Android settings check.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/yuroyami/KiteConfig/compare/v3.0.1...v3.1.0
